verdict.rationale: OpenRouter docs describe privacy controls—restricting requests/account-wide to providers with certain data policies, opting out of providers that train on data, and enterprise in-region routing (openrouter-docs-12,13,25,33)—which map to a retention-control story, and the providers page even lists a 'Retention'/'Trains' column per provider (openrouter-docs-48). However, hands-on community reports directly contradict the strength of this: 'No ZDR. No dice' and 'no true guarantees of ZDR/privacy/data sovereignty' (openrouter-comm-4, openrouter-comm-16), indicating the zero-data-retention promise doesn't hold for all providers/routes as users expect. There is no documented user-initiated data deletion mechanism at all. Missing for 10: explicit data-deletion API/feature, first-party confirmation of true ZDR across providers, and resolution of the community-reported gap.
